review.tagline: Free LLM course with roadmaps and Colab notebooks for fine-tuning and quantization
review.summary: A three-part course covering LLM fundamentals (math, Python, neural networks), an LLM Scientist track on building models, and an LLM Engineer track on building and deploying applications. It pairs roadmaps and curated links with Colab notebooks and articles on fine-tuning (Unsloth, ORPO, DPO, QLoRA, Axolotl), quantization (GGUF, GPTQ, EXL2) and model merging with MergeKit.
review.audience: Engineers learning to fine-tune, quantize and deploy LLMs
strengths: Runnable Colab notebooks for fine-tuning, quantization and merging, most with a linked article
Separate tracks for fundamentals, model building and application deployment
Quantization notebooks cover GGUF, GPTQ, EXL2, AWQ and HQQ
weaknesses: Mostly curated external links rather than self-contained lessons
Several notebooks target older models such as Llama 2 and Mistral-7b
Notebooks run on Google Colab or RunPod, not a documented local setup
Coverage reflects one author's selection of topics and resources
needs: Needs Google Colab, RunPod, Hugging Face
Models: Llama 3.1, Llama 3, Llama 2, Mistral-7b, CodeLlama
